user.title: Poly Studio video bar
user.description: SNMP v2c must be enabled on the device. The user name and password are optional: they are the device's admin login and enable the REST controls (mute, volume, end call, reboot).

reconfigure.title: Poly Studio video bar
reconfigure.description: Leave the password empty to use SNMP monitoring only.

error.cannot_connect: No SNMP response, or the device does not expose the Poly endpoint MIB.
error.invalid_auth: The device rejected the admin user name or password.
error.rest_cannot_connect: SNMP works, but the REST API at https://<host>/rest could not be reached.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: That host is a different device.
